prompt_design_risks_to_test: v3 puts five distinct beats into 6 seconds, which may exceed what one generation can execute.
Negative phrasing such as 'No female instructor' can prime the model to include the thing it names. Unverified.
Telling the model to replace a person in a reference image conflicts with the image itself. Editing the reference image may work better. Unverified.
Long taglines rendered inside the video may morph. Adding text in post may be safer. Unverified.
'cinematic 8k' style tokens may add little. Unverified.
